title: Presentation Content Centering
description: All presentation content must be centered horizontally and vertically. Projektetage intro currently starts at the top because text dispositions incorrectly use the positioned canvas layout.
summary:
Fixed intro flow slides (e.g. Ziel) pushing content to the bottom of the viewport.

Root cause: `.presentation-arrangement--interactive { position: relative }` overrode reveal.js `position: absolute` on nested stack sections, so past/present/future intro slides flowed vertically instead of overlaying — the present slide content appeared at the bottom.

Fix: removed `position: relative` from the interactive section rule; reveal.js stack positioning and centering work again. Added regression test asserting globals.css does not reintroduce that override. Verified live on projektetage :6050 Ziel and Titel slides. All 34 renderer tests pass.
